summary: QA: all 3 acceptance criteria of FEAT-042 observed in the sandbox, including isolation between users and filter+pagination after reload.
checked_criteria: AC-1 user sees only own operations (checked as user-a and user-b)
AC-2 filter and pagination work together after reload
AC-3 empty filter result shows empty state, not an error

criteria.action: GET /api/history as user-a, then as user-b; compare owner_id of rows with DB
criteria.observed: user-a receives 42 rows all owner_id=user-a; user-b receives 7 rows all owner_id=user-b; DB counts match

criteria.action: Filter by type=transfer, open page 2, reload browser
criteria.observed: Page 2 shows 10 transfer rows owned by user-a; URL keeps type=transfer&page=2 and same rows after reload

criteria.action: Filter by type=refund for user-b (no refunds seeded)
criteria.observed: Empty state 'No operations match the filter' rendered, HTTP 200 with items=[]
